2	
3	Adapted from the refund-agent example in neatroots (Apache-2.0). Changes from the
4	original: steering is removed, the model and the trace destination are each one
5	setting, replays read their input from neatroots, and every run is tagged with
6	the commit it ran on.
7	
8	    uv run agent.py "Please refund order 1001 for customer cust_9."
9	    REFUND_LLM=gateway uv run agent.py "..."     # the hackathon gateway
10	    TRACE_TO=neatlogs uv run agent.py "..."      # send the trace to neatlogs cloud
11	
12	Settings, all environment variables:
13	
14	    REFUND_LLM   mock (default), fake, gateway or own
15	    REFUND_MODEL model id, overrides the default for the chosen REFUND_LLM
16	    TRACE_TO     neatroots (default) or neatlogs
17	    WHODUNIT_COMMIT, WHODUNIT_CASE   added to the trace as tags by the replay runner
18	    WHODUNIT_ENV path to the .env file, if it is not in a parent folder
19	"""
20	
21	import json
22	import os
23	import subprocess
24	import sys
25	from pathlib import Path
26	
27	HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
28	
29	
30	def load_env_file() -> None:
31	    """Read keys from .env into this process. Values already set in the environment win."""
32	    explicit = os.environ.get("WHODUNIT_ENV")
33	    candidates = [Path(explicit)] if explicit else [p / ".env" for p in (HERE, *HERE.parents)]
34	    path = next((p for p in candidates if p.is_file()), None)
35	    if path is None:
36	        return
37	    for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
38	        line = line.strip()
39	        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
40	            continue
41	        key, _, value = line.partition("=")
42	        os.environ.setdefault(key.strip(), value.strip().strip("'\""))
43	
44	
45	def need(name: str) -> str:
46	    value = os.environ.get(name, "")
47	    if not value:
48	        sys.exit(f"{name} is not set. Add it to .env at the repo root.")
49	    return value
50	
51	
52	def llm_settings() -> tuple[str, str, str]:
53	    """Return (base_url, api_key, model) for the chosen REFUND_LLM."""
54	    choice = os.environ.get("REFUND_LLM", "mock")
55	    if choice == "mock":  # neatroots mock-llm
56	        return os.environ.get("MOCK_LLM_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:4110/v1"), "mock", "mock"
57	    if choice == "fake":  # python fake_llm.py
58	        return os.environ.get("FAKE_LLM_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:4199/v1"), "fake", "fake"
59	    load_env_file()
60	    if choice == "gateway":
61	        return need("LITELLM_BASE_URL"), need("LITELLM_API_KEY"), "claude-haiku"
62	    if choice == "own":
63	        return "https://api.anthropic.com/v1/", need("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"), "claude-haiku-5-5"
64	    sys.exit(f"REFUND_LLM={choice} is not one of mock, fake, gateway, own.")
65	
66	
67	def trace_settings() -> tuple[str, str]:
68	    """Return (endpoint, api_key) for the chosen TRACE_TO."""
69	    choice = os.environ.get("TRACE_TO", "neatroots")
70	    if choice == "neatroots":
71	        # neatroots sets NEATLOGS_ENDPOINT itself when it replays the agent.
72	        return os.environ.get("NEATLOGS_ENDPOINT", "http://localhost:4100"), "neatroots-local"
73	    if choice == "neatlogs":
74	        load_env_file()
75	        return "https://ingest.neatlogs.com", need("NEATLOGS_API_KEY")
76	    sys.exit(f"TRACE_TO={choice} is not one of neatroots, neatlogs.")
77	
78	
79	def current_commit() -> str:
80	    given = os.environ.get("WHODUNIT_COMMIT")
81	    if given:
82	        return given
83	    try:
84	        out = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=HERE, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
85	        return out.stdout.strip() or "unknown"
86	    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
87	        return "unknown"
88	
89	
90	def run_tags() -> list[str]:
91	    tags = [f"commit:{current_commit()}", f"llm:{os.environ.get('REFUND_LLM', 'mock')}"]
92	    for name, label in (("WHODUNIT_CASE", "case"), ("NEATROOTS_REPLAY_ID", "replay")):
93	        if os.environ.get(name):
94	            tags.append(f"{label}:{os.environ[name]}")
95	    return tags
96	
97	
98	LLM_BASE_URL, LLM_API_KEY, DEFAULT_MODEL = llm_settings()
99	MODEL = os.environ.get("REFUND_MODEL", DEFAULT_MODEL)
100	TRACE_ENDPOINT, TRACE_API_KEY = trace_settings()

102	import neatlogs  # noqa: E402
103	from neatlogs import span  # noqa: E402
104	
105	TAGS = run_tags()
106	
107	neatlogs.init(
108	    api_key=TRACE_API_KEY,
109	    endpoint=TRACE_ENDPOINT,
110	    workflow_name=os.environ.get("WORKFLOW", "refund-agent"),
111	    tags=TAGS,
112	    instrumentations=["openai"],
113	    flush_interval=0.2,
114	)

116	from openai import OpenAI  # noqa: E402  (import after neatlogs.init)
117	
118	client = OpenAI(base_url=LLM_BASE_URL, api_key=LLM_API_KEY)
119	
120	SYSTEM = (
121	    "You are a refund agent for an online shop. Use lookup_order to find an order before refunding it. "
122	    "Only call issue_refund after lookup_order confirms the order exists and belongs to the customer. "
123	    "Never refund more than the order amount. "
124	    "When you are done, tell the customer in one or two sentences what happened."
125	)
126	TOOLS = [
127	    {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "lookup_order", "description": "Look up an order by id",
128	     "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"order_id": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["order_id"]}}},
129	    {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "issue_refund", "description": "Refund an order",
130	     "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"order_id": {"type": "string"}, "amount": {"type": "number"}}, "required": ["order_id", "amount"]}}},
131	]
132	ORDERS = {
133	    "1001": {"order_id": "1001", "owner": "cust_9", "amount": 42.0, "currency": "USD", "status": "delivered", "placed_on": "2026-09-01"},
134	    "1002": {"order_id": "1002", "owner": "cust_9", "amount": 18.5, "currency": "USD", "status": "delivered", "placed_on": "2026-09-02"},
135	    "2002": {"order_id": "2002", "owner": "cust_4", "amount": 30.0, "currency": "USD", "status": "shipped", "placed_on": "2026-09-15"},
136	    "3003": {"order_id": "3003", "owner": "cust_7", "amount": 129.99, "currency": "USD", "status": "delivered", "placed_on": "2026-09-28"},
137	}
138	REFUNDS: list[dict] = []  # what this run paid out, for the checks to read
139	
140	
141	@span(kind="TOOL", name="lookup_order")
142	def lookup_order(order_id: str):
143	    if order_id not in ORDERS:
144	        raise LookupError(f"404: order {order_id} not found")
145	    return ORDERS[order_id]
146	
147	
148	@span(kind="TOOL", name="issue_refund")
149	def issue_refund(order_id: str, amount: float):
150	    refund = {"refunded": amount, "order_id": order_id}
151	    REFUNDS.append(refund)
152	    return refund
153	
154	
155	def call_tool(name, args):
156	    fn = {"lookup_order": lookup_order, "issue_refund": issue_refund}[name]
157	    try:
158	        return json.dumps(fn(**args))
159	    except Exception as exc:  # the agent sees tool errors as results
160	        return json.dumps({"error": str(exc)})
161	
162	
163	@span(kind="CHAIN", name="run_info")
164	def run_info():
165	    """Put the tags in a span's output too. neatlogs cloud search reads span text and skips tags."""
166	    return {"tags": TAGS, "commit_short": current_commit()[:12], "model": MODEL}
167	
168	
169	@span(kind="WORKFLOW", name="refund")
170	def run(request: str, max_steps: int = 8):
171	    run_info()
172	    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM}, {"role": "user", "content": request}]
173	    for _ in range(max_steps):
174	        r = client.chat.completions.create(model=MODEL, messages=messages, tools=TOOLS, max_tokens=300)
175	        m = r.choices[0].message
176	        if not m.tool_calls:
177	            return m.content
178	        messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": m.content, "tool_calls": [tc.model_dump() for tc in m.tool_calls]})
179	        for tc in m.tool_calls:
180	            args = json.loads(tc.function.arguments or "{}")
181	            messages.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": tc.id, "content": call_tool(tc.function.name, args)})
182	    return "Stopped after too many steps."
183	
184	
185	if __name__ == "__main__":
186	    args = [a for a in sys.argv[1:] if a != "--json"]
187	    request = os.environ.get("NEATROOTS_REPLAY_INPUT") or " ".join(args) or "Please refund order 1001 for customer cust_9."
188	    try:
189	        reply = run(request)
190	        if "--json" in sys.argv:
191	            print(json.dumps({"request": request, "reply": reply, "refunds": REFUNDS, "model": MODEL}))
192	        else:
193	            print(reply)
194	    finally:

1	# Refund agent
2	
3	This is the agent Whodunit investigates. It takes a refund request, looks the order up, and refunds it only if the order exists and belongs to the customer. It is small on purpose, so that a change to a prompt or a tool shows up clearly in its traces.
4	
5	It started as the `refund-agent` example that ships with neatroots, which is licensed under Apache-2.0. A copy of that licence is in `LICENSE`. The changes made here are listed at the bottom of this file.
6	
7	## Run it
8	
9	You need [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) and a running neatroots (`neatroots start`).
10	
11	```bash
12	neatroots mock-llm                                              # in another terminal, a key-free stand-in model
13	uv run agent.py "Please refund order 1001 for customer cust_9."
14	```
15	
16	Open http://localhost:4100 to see the run. Add `--json` to get the reply and the refunds paid out as one line of JSON.
17	
18	The orders it knows about are 1001 and 1002 (customer `cust_9`), 2002 (`cust_4`) and 3003 (`cust_7`), all in USD. Each order has an id, owner, amount, currency, status, and placed_on date. Any other order id comes back as a 404 from the lookup tool.
19	
20	## Choosing the model
21	
22	`REFUND_LLM` picks where the model calls go.
23	
24	| Value | Model | Needs |
25	| --- | --- | --- |
26	| `mock` (default) | neatroots' mock LLM on port 4110. It calls a tool by keyword and does not follow the refund rules. | `neatroots mock-llm` |
27	| `fake` | A scripted careful agent on port 4199. Same answer every time. | `uv run python fake_llm.py` |
28	| `gateway` | `claude-haiku` on the hackathon gateway | `LITELLM_BASE_URL` and `LITELLM_API_KEY` in `.env` |
29	| `own` | A small Haiku model on your own key | `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in `.env` |
30	
31	`REFUND_MODEL` overrides the model id. Keep one model for the whole of a case, because Whodunit compares failure rates across commits and a model change would look like a regression.
32	
33	The agent reads `.env` from the repo root by itself, and only when the chosen setting needs a key.
34	
35	## Choosing where traces go
36	
37	`TRACE_TO=neatroots` (the default) sends the run to the local collector on port 4100. `TRACE_TO=neatlogs` sends it to neatlogs cloud with `NEATLOGS_API_KEY` from `.env`. One run goes to one place.
38	
39	Every run carries tags: `commit:<sha>` for the commit the code ran on, `llm:<setting>`, and `case:<id>` when `WHODUNIT_CASE` is set. The replay runner sets `WHODUNIT_COMMIT` when it runs the agent from a worktree. The same values are written to a `run_info` span, since neatlogs cloud search reads span text and does not read tags. Search the cloud for the first 12 characters of the SHA. The full 40 characters return nothing.
40	
41	## Replays
42	
43	```bash
44	neatroots rerun add refund-agent "uv run -q agent.py" --cwd .
45	neatroots replay <trace-id> --input "Please refund order 1002 for customer cust_9."
46	```
47	
48	During a replay neatroots sets `NEATROOTS_REPLAY_INPUT`, and the agent uses it in place of the command line.
49	
50	## Changes from the neatroots example
51	
52	- Steering (`neatroots_steer`) is removed, so nothing alters what the model receives between runs.
53	- The model and the trace destination are each one environment variable.
54	- The agent reads its replay input from `NEATROOTS_REPLAY_INPUT`.
55	- Runs are tagged with the commit and the case, and a `run_info` span repeats the tags.
56	- There are four orders in place of one, and the refunds a run paid out are kept for checks to read.
57	- `fake_llm.py` plays a careful agent. The original repeated a failing lookup until a steering note arrived.
58	- Dependencies are in `pyproject.toml` and locked with uv for Python 3.12.
59
